target.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-sonnet-5 to bundled 1M-context catalog
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Claude Sonnet 5 (`claude-sonnet-5`) ships from Anthropic with a 1,000,000-token
context window as both default and maximum, but the bundled Anthropic catalog and
the GA-1M prefix allow-list predate the model, so nothing recognizes it:

- `extensions/anthropic/openclaw.plugin.json` has no `claude-sonnet-5` entry under
  either the `anthropic` or `claude-cli` provider.
- `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` — duplicated in `src/agents/context-resolution.ts`
  and `extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.ts` — does not list the model.

As a result `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow()` returns `undefined` for
`claude-sonnet-5`, and context resolution falls back to 200k. A user who adds the
model sees `200k ctx` in `openclaw status` and loses the GA-1M beta-header decision
even though the model is a native 1M-context model. Reported in #99239.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `claude-sonnet-5` where the other GA-1M Anthropic models already live, so the
existing resolution path recognizes it:

- Add the model to both provider lists in the bundled catalog with
  `contextWindow: 1048576` (matching the Opus 4.8 convention and
  `ANTHROPIC_CONTEXT_1M_TOKENS`) and `maxTokens: 128000`.
- Add the single prefix `"claude-sonnet-5"` to both copies of
  `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES`. `startsWith` matching means this one entry
  covers dated (`claude-sonnet-5-20260630`) and dotted (`claude-sonnet-5.0`)
  variants, so no redundant entries are needed.

Scope is limited to catalog data + the prefix constant; no resolution logic
changes. The pre-existing duplication of the prefix list across two files is
untouched here (it is called out in the issue as a separate cleanup).

## User Impact

`claude-sonnet-5` now resolves to its true 1M context window in status output and
GA-1M header logic instead of defaulting to 200k. No behavior change for any other
model.

## Evidence

Regression coverage added to `src/agents/context.test.ts` (the existing GA-1M
table): three rows asserting `resolveContextTokensForModel` returns the fixed 1M
window for `claude-sonnet-5` across `anthropic`, `claude-cli`, and `anthropic-vertex`.
These rows fail before the fix (model resolves to the 200k fallback) and pass after.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** `claude-sonnet-5` now resolves to the fixed 1M Anthropic
context window (1048576 for anthropic / claude-cli, 1000000 for anthropic-vertex)
instead of falling back to 200k.

**Environment tested:** Node v24.18.0 on Windows; production TypeScript source
invoked directly via `node --import tsx` against the fix branch.

**Steps run after the patch:** Called the actual patched production functions
`resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` and `resolveContextTokensForModel` from source,
comparing behavior with and without the prefix entry.

**Evidence after fix:** Before the patch (prefix entry removed), the real function
returns the 200k fallback:

```text
anthropic    claude-sonnet-5 => undefined  (defaults to 200000)
claude-cli   claude-sonnet-5 => undefined  (defaults to 200000)
```

After the patch, `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` from source:

```text
anthropic          claude-sonnet-5                => 1048576
anthropic          anthropic/claude-sonnet-5      => 1048576
claude-cli         claude-sonnet-5                => 1048576
anthropic-vertex   claude-sonnet-5                => 1000000
anthropic          claude-sonnet-5-20260630       => 1048576
```

And the wrapper `resolveContextTokensForModel` (the exact rows added to the
regression table):

```text
PASS anthropic        claude-sonnet-5 expected 1048576 got 1048576
PASS claude-cli       claude-sonnet-5 expected 1048576 got 1048576
PASS anthropic-vertex claude-sonnet-5 expected 1000000 got 1000000
ALL REGRESSION ROWS PASS: true
```

Bundled catalog parses and exposes the new entry under both providers:

```text
catalog JSON parses OK
claude-cli sonnet-5 ctx=1048576 max=128000
anthropic  sonnet-5 ctx=1048576 max=128000
```

**Observed result after the fix:** `claude-sonnet-5` is treated as a native 1M model
by the resolver on all three Anthropic providers; the bundled catalog lists it with
`contextWindow: 1048576`.

**Not tested:** A live `openclaw status` render against a running gateway with a real
Anthropic account was not exercised; verification was against the production
resolution functions and the bundled catalog only.

Closes #99239
